title: VYRN perception engine
purpose: Process media once into a persistent, queryable store of timestamped observations (entities with identity, motion, spatial relations, sound events, confidence, evidence) so agents ask narrow questions instead of re-watching video.

commands.ingest: ingest <video|timeline.json> [--force] [--render final.mp4] -> media id (cached by sha256 + processor version)

inputs.native: paper-cinema-timeline/1 (docs/TIMELINE-FORMAT.md); Blender and Unreal adapters write the same shape

fields.conf: 0..1 (1 = ground truth from the source environment)

event_format.compatible_with: timeline events (docs/TIMELINE-FORMAT.md §10): same ids and type names; extra fields live in data

cache.key: sha256 of the file bytes + processor versions (vyrn/ingest.py VERSION)
